title: Find Duplicate Number
contract: An array of n+1 entries contains values in [1,n] with exactly one distinct duplicated value, possibly repeated more than twice. Do not mutate it.
brute: for(int i=0;i<a.length;i++)for(int j=0;j<i;j++){emit("Compare two positions","indices",new int[]{j,i});if(a[i]==a[j])return a[i];}throw new IllegalArgumentException("Missing duplicate");
optimal: int slow=a[0],fast=a[0];do{slow=a[slow];fast=a[a[fast]];emit("Meet inside the implicit index cycle","slow",slow,"fast",fast);}while(slow!=fast);slow=a[0];while(slow!=fast){slow=a[slow];fast=a[fast];emit("Find the cycle entrance","slow",slow,"fast",fast);}return slow;
reasoning: The direct pair scan detects equality without modifying the array.
Interpret values as next indices. The value domain keeps every step valid and the duplicate creates a reachable cycle entrance.
Floyd's first phase meets inside the cycle; resetting one pointer and advancing equally finds the entrance. This method is invalid for arbitrary integers outside [1,n].
